title.en: vLLM #41530: tracing the first loss of worker progress
title.zh-CN: vLLM #41530：追踪 worker 最初失去进展的位置

source_scope.en: Candidate based on the inspected public issue and visible discussion. No local reproduction, captured CoroPerf trace or fix validation has been performed. No causal fix was identified in the inspected material; this is not an exhaustive repository-wide absence claim.
source_scope.zh-CN: 候选依据已检查的公开 issue 与可见讨论建立；尚未执行本地复现、采集 CoroPerf 轨迹或验证修复。所读材料未发现根因修复，不代表已穷尽整个仓库。

question.en: Which execution stops making progress before the sample_tokens RPC times out?
question.zh-CN: sample_tokens RPC 超时之前，哪段执行首先停止进展？

known.en: Workers become unresponsive without an exception. A recent report still describes silent stalls on 0.33.0; the discussion contains distinct failure modes that must be separated.
known.zh-CN: worker 无异常地失去响应；最近的 0.33.0 报告仍有静默停顿，讨论中混有不同失败模式，需要分开处理。

repair_status.en: Upstream describes #58779 as bounding the wait, not eliminating the stall. Disabling adaptive verification is a suggested diagnostic direction, not a confirmed fix for the selected failure. No causal repair was identified in the inspected discussion and targeted PR search.
repair_status.zh-CN: 上游说明 #58779 限制等待时间，但没有消除底层停顿。禁用 adaptive verification 是待检验方向，不是所选失败的已确认修复。本轮讨论与定向 PR 搜索未发现针对该停顿的已验证修复。

first_step.en: Collect the same failing H200/model/request workload with the prepared host probes plus worker/native/device progress. Compare matching RPC generations and rank budgets before testing an adaptive-verification change.
first_step.zh-CN: 在同一H200／模型／请求负载上，结合已准备的主机探针与worker原生／设备进展采集；匹配RPC代次和rank预算后，再检验adaptive verification改动。

next_action.en: Collect the same failing H200/model/request workload with the prepared host probes plus worker/native/device progress. Compare matching RPC generations and rank budgets before testing an adaptive-verification change.
next_action.zh-CN: 在同一H200／模型／请求负载上，结合已准备的主机探针与worker原生／设备进展采集；匹配RPC代次和rank预算后，再检验adaptive verification改动。

proposed_addition.en: Connect initiating request and batch histories to the specific RPC, worker generation and rank; identify the earliest missing progress event.
proposed_addition.zh-CN: 把发起请求、batch 历史接到具体 RPC、worker 代次与 rank，定位最早缺失的进展事件。

limits.en: The incident remains unreproduced. Preparation checks use explicit collector fixtures, not vLLM inference. Collection overhead, trace effects on the rare schedule, device completion and root cause are unmeasured.
limits.zh-CN: 原故障尚未复现。准备检查使用明确的采集器fixture，不是vLLM推理；采集开销、对罕见时序的影响、设备完成及根因均未测得。

claim.zh-CN: worker 侧 CPU 执行先失去进展。

distinguish.en: Correlate native sampled stacks with the exact batch/RPC and distinguish active execution from a blocked wait.
distinguish.zh-CN: 将原生采样栈关联到精确 batch／RPC，区分持续执行与阻塞等待。

claim.en: A device event or collective stops before the RPC reply.
claim.zh-CN: 设备事件或 collective 先停住，RPC 回复随后缺失。

distinguish.en: Require matching launch/completion and rank progress evidence; an RPC timeout alone cannot identify this cause.
distinguish.zh-CN: 需要匹配的发起／完成及 rank 进展证据，单凭 RPC 超时不能确定该原因。

claim.en: Reply routing or lifetime bookkeeping loses an otherwise completed operation.
claim.zh-CN: 操作已完成，但回复路由或生命周期记账丢失它。

distinguish.en: Show completion for the same operation generation before its missing reply; worker liveness alone is insufficient.
distinguish.zh-CN: 先证明同一操作代次已完成，再确认其回复缺失；worker 仍存活不足以支持这一解释。

required_relations.en: Request/batch/RPC identities; process and rank generations; native worker stacks; device-event or collective progress; ordered dispatch and completion. These bridges need implementation and validation.
required_relations.zh-CN: request／batch／RPC 身份、进程和 rank 代次、原生 worker 栈、设备事件或 collective 进展、派发与完成次序；这些关联仍需实现和验证。

comparisons.en: Recover one reporter configuration, workload inputs and native traces; establish that the same silent stall still reproduces.
comparisons.zh-CN: 先取得一位报告者的配置、负载输入与原生轨迹，确认同一种静默停顿仍可复现。

comparisons.en: Select one silent-worker report and preserve its exact build, model and load. Compare healthy and stalled runs before a cause-specific repair; separate other exception and timeout-only cases.
comparisons.zh-CN: 选定一条静默 worker 报告，保留精确构建、模型与负载；比较正常／停顿轨迹，再验证针对原因的修复，分开处理异常退出与仅超时的其他子案例。

comparisons.en: Compare the same captured observations using ordinary diagnostics and CoroPerf. Test a cause-specific repair only after the first missing progress event is established.
comparisons.zh-CN: 以同一批采集观察比较普通诊断与 CoroPerf；建立第一个缺失进展事件后，再验证针对原因的修复。

ordinary.en: Existing diagnostics show the timeout path; different reports in this issue may represent different failures.
ordinary.zh-CN: 现有诊断显示超时路径，但 issue 内的不同报告可能不是同一种失败。

with_coroperf.en: Connect initiating request and batch histories to the specific RPC, worker generation and rank; identify the earliest missing progress event.
with_coroperf.zh-CN: 把发起请求、batch 历史接到具体 RPC、worker 代次与 rank，定位最早缺失的进展事件。

progress_notes.en: The pinned 0.33.0 revision 4ba787ec has 19 matching source selections. Seven collector engineering checks pass, including real Runner-managed uvloop, preservation of an application Task factory, and durable Task creation history before a blocked process can exit. Original incident executions remain zero.
progress_notes.zh-CN: 固定的 0.33.0 revision 4ba787ec 匹配 19 个源码选择点。七项采集器工程检查通过，覆盖真实 Runner-managed uvloop、保留应用 Task factory，以及阻塞进程退出前的 Task 创建历史落盘；原故障执行次数仍为零。

progress_notes.en: Source analysis: adaptive verification chooses a local draft budget, followed by graph/DP dispatch. This supplies an observation point for the suggested rank-disagreement hypothesis, not evidence that disagreement caused this incident. The default 300 s RPC deadline and 60 s first warning account for roughly 240 s from first warning to fatal; 239 s in second-resolution logs does not identify a worker cause.
progress_notes.zh-CN: 源码分析：adaptive verification 在本地选择 draft 预算，再进入 graph／DP 派发。这给 rank 分歧假设提供了观察点，尚不能证明原故障由分歧造成。默认300秒 RPC deadline 与60秒首条告警解释了约240秒的告警到退出时长；秒级日志中的239秒不是 worker 首因证据。

progress_notes.en: The selected report uses 4×H200 and a 475 GiB DeepSeekV4.1Flash checkpoint. The inspected local environment has 8×A100 and lacks that checkpoint. A small-model run would be a separate control, not reproduction of this incident. Host progress does not establish CUDA/NCCL completion.
progress_notes.zh-CN: 所选报告使用4×H200及475GiB的DeepSeekV4.1Flash checkpoint。本地已检查环境为8×A100，未找到该checkpoint。小模型运行只能作为另一个对照，不能称为原故障复现；主机事件也不证明CUDA／NCCL已经完成。

progress_notes.en: In an isolated check using the unchanged FutureWrapper source class, three completed submitting Tasks were linked to three later synchronous waits through the captured Future and response-closure identities. Baseline and profiled callback results agree. These controlled callbacks do not reproduce the engine stall or validate its cause.
progress_notes.zh-CN: 在使用未改动 FutureWrapper 源码类的独立组件检查中，通过记录的 Future 与响应闭包身份，将三个已结束的提交 Task 分别关联到之后的三次同步等待。开启采集前后的回调结果一致。回调输入为受控测试，不是原引擎停顿的复现或根因验证。
